raw_text: I compared the viral 'Chinese base in Ladakh' satellite image against the latest Sentinel-2 and Planet Labs imagery of the exact same coordinates. There are NO structures at that location. The image shows clear GAN artifacts — repeating texture patterns in the terrain and shadow angles that are physically impossible for the claimed acquisition time. This is synthetic imagery.
clean_text: Comparison with Sentinel-2 and Planet Labs imagery shows no structures at claimed coordinates. GAN artifacts detected including repeating texture patterns and impossible shadow angles.
